content.title: 2026 TCS New York City Marathon
content.text: Apply to be a part of Team PAWS NY for the TCS New York City Marathon! Once again, PAWS NY has been named an Official Charity Partner of the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon! Apply here to run for PAWS! This iconic 26.2-mile race through the five boroughs of NYC will take place on Sunday, November 1, 2026. If you're interested in achieving an incredible athletic feat of completing a marathon while helping to raise funds and awareness for people and pets in need, learn more and apply today. Benefits/Requirements: Fundraising minimum of $3,500 is required and due by Monday, October 26, 2026 (unless you already have guaranteed entry via another way) Runners are responsible for paying the Race Registration Fee directly to New York Road Runners ($255 for NYRR Members and $295 for non-NYRR Members) Official Team PAWS NY race shirt PAWS NY swag (tote bag, water bottle, bandana, face mask, hand sanitizer, and more) Personal online fundraising page via Classy, with fundraising support provided by PAWS NY Two complimentary tickets to our 2027 spring fundraiser for the team member who raises the most money Please visit the New York Road Runner website for more information about safety procedures for the organization's races in 2026. We use cookies on our website to give you the most relevant experience by remembering your preferences and repeat visits. By clicking “Accept”, you consent to the use of ALL the cookies.
